title: JPMORGAN CHASE & CO 8-K Filing — 2026-04-14
summary: JPMorgan Chase reported Q1 2026 net income of $16.5 billion ($5.94 per share), up from $14.6 billion ($5.07 per share) in Q1 2025. This is a routine 8-K filing providing first quarter earnings headline numbers. Detailed earnings release and financial supplement (Exhibits 99.1 and 99.2) are referenced but not included in the filing body text.
